items.label: Cat Litter Box Enclosure for 2 Cats
items.value: This cat litter box cabinet can be used by two cats at the same time, featuring separate litter box design, two cats won't interfere with each other, which greatly improves the privacy of cats. Each litter cabinet measures 22.2x17.7x18.1 inches and fits most litter boxes

items.label: More Privacy, Less Smell
items.value: This cat litter box enclosure provides your cat with a secluded and relaxing toilet space, avoiding litter scattering, reducing smell and keeping the room tidy

items.label: Multi-purpose Pet Furniture
items.value: Not only is it a cat litter box enclosure, it can also be used as a cat house or an end table or TV table next to the sofa, the rustic style and unique barn door shape can easily fit into most home styles

items.label: More Thoughtful Details
items.value: the porch is carpeted to prevent litter from scattering; the scratching ball with bell allows cats to play happily; ventilation holes allow cats to enjoy fresh air and soft light; the sturdy door lock and magnetic lock prevents cats from accidentally knocking it open while using it, and is dog-proof

items.label: Stress-free Assembly
items.value: Can't wait for your cat to try out the hidden litter box furniture during assembly? No worries, with step-by-step instructions and labeled parts, you can assemble it in less than an hour.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Accessory Bag, 1 x Assembly Instructions, 1 x Litter Box Enclosure
